findings.finding: Invalid model configuration still becomes an invisible inherited tier. The client ignores the endpoint's warning, so malformed/non-object config is displayed as ordinary inherit under project default. Invalid recognized-role values and unknown keys also produce no warning.
findings.suggestion: Mark invalid recognized-role values and unsupported config structure/keys as model_config_invalid, render a compact warning state, and test malformed plus invalid-role cases through the component/API boundary.

findings.finding: The central linked-worktree behavior is untested. Existing tests exercise only the non-Git fallback, although the implementation promises config is read from the main Git root rather than a linked worktree.
findings.suggestion: Add a real-repository linked-worktree boundary test with divergent config copies and assert the main-root copy wins.
